events.title: Aperture awakening ceremony
events.summary: Fang Yuan awakens a C-grade aperture, deliberately mediocre, while his twin brother Fang Zheng awakens A-grade talent and becomes the clan's hope. Fang Yuan's real assets are five hundred years of memories and the hidden Spring Autumn Cicada.

events.title: Flower Wine Temple discovery
events.summary: Using prior-life knowledge, Fang Yuan locates the Flower Wine Temple legacy before anyone else and secures the Liquor Worm, an asset the clan considers near-worthless, converting it into a long-term essence-quality engine.

events.title: Liquor Worm essence refinement period
events.summary: Fang Yuan secretly uses the Liquor Worm to upgrade his primeval essence quality while publicly cultivating slowly, investing in a process that compounds instead of visible short-term rank gains.

events.title: Qing Tao / clan academy manipulation
events.summary: Fang Yuan plays the mediocre student, manipulating clan assessments, subsidies, and expectations to bank resources and conceal his true pace.

events.title: Blood Moon / demonic breakout at Qing Mao Mountain
events.summary: Fang Yuan's demonic path deeds force open conflict with the Gu Yue clan; he converts an exposed position into an escape operation during the chaos, accepting permanent exile in exchange for survival and freedom.

events.title: Alliance with Bai Ning Bing
events.summary: Fang Yuan and the A-grade genius Bai Ning Bing form a temporary cooperative alliance during the mountain crisis; each uses the other as an instrument, with mutual awareness that it is transactional.

events.title: Escape from Qing Mao Mountain
events.summary: Trapped by stronger forces, Fang Yuan converts the battle into an escape: Bai Ning Bing's Yin-Yang Rotation Gu opens the path; survival and continuation outrank winning the fight or saving face.

events.title: Joining the merchant caravan
events.summary: Fang Yuan joins a merchant caravan as a hired escort, trading short-term profit for access, information, and temporary anonymity while traveling toward Shang clan city; he participates selectively, exploiting the caravan's information gap.

events.title: Mudskin Toad acquisition
events.summary: Fang Yuan acquires the Mudskin Toad Gu, valuing its utility for concealment and survival over flashier combat assets.

events.title: Arrival at Shang clan city
events.summary: Fang Yuan enters the Shang clan's commercial hub, shifting strategy from combat concealment to commerce: identity management, transaction discipline, and information arbitrage under a mask.

events.title: Jia Jin Sheng transaction
events.summary: A transaction with the merchant Jia Jin Sheng leaves residue beyond its price: witnesses, politics, investigation, retaliation risk. Fang Yuan internalizes the shadow cost of deals.

events.title: Commerce and auction period in Shang city
events.summary: Fang Yuan runs a disciplined commercial campaign: buying, refining, selling under controlled identity, never letting capital idle, pricing by information asymmetry rather than sentiment.

events.title: Rebirth into Northern Plains power games
events.summary: Operating among the tribes, Fang Yuan shifts to long-horizon planning: inheritances, alliances of convenience, and patience across seasons rather than single victories.

events.title: Imperial Court contest participation
events.summary: Fang Yuan enters the Northern Plains imperial court contest as an instrument, using the competition for access to inheritances and position rather than honor.

events.title: Zombie period transformation
events.summary: Facing lethal pressure, Fang Yuan accepts a zombie-type existence-transformation: identity and body are instruments; continued action outranks normal form.

events.title: Immortal ascension and factional warfare
events.summary: Upon reaching Gu Immortal rank, Fang Yuan's scale shifts to immortal apertures, Blessed Lands, and faction warfare against super forces; timing tribulations and leveraging formation-level assets.

events.title: Western Desert spider trade with Xiao clan
events.summary: Fang Yuan identifies the Xiao clan transport/economic formation's recurring input requirement and becomes its supplier, extracting recurring value and internal information without direct confrontation.

events.title: Reverse Flow River strategic period
events.summary: At world-scale play (River of Time mechanics, venerable legacies), Fang Yuan's calculations extend across eras; fate, tribulations, and venerable inheritances become allocable resources.

events.title: Crazed Demon Cave rules period
events.summary: Inside the Crazed Demon Cave's rule-system, Fang Yuan deduces and exploits rules themselves; Dao marks, deduction, and the limits of the world become the battlefield.

events.title: Conflict with Heavenly Court's Longevity plan
events.summary: Fang Yuan's fixed objective (eternal life) drives world-scale resource allocation and direct opposition to Heaven's Will and Heavenly Court's order-maintenance agenda.

events.title: Novel cancellation at chapter 2334
events.summary: The novel was banned and cancelled in 2019 at chapter 2334, unfinished; Fang Yuan's arc ends mid-escalation, which the decision corpus must respect (no invented endings).

events.title: Five hundred year regression via Spring Autumn Cicada
events.summary: At the end of a failed 500-year life, Fang Yuan refines and uses the Spring Autumn Cicada to return to his youth with full memory: the novel's premise and its long-horizon logic (a path that survives even personal death).
